storage: Keep whole in a cool, dry, ventilated spot, not in the fridge. Once cut, wrap and refrigerate and use within about 3 days; cooked yam keeps 2 to 3 days in the fridge.
looksLike: A large, rough, dark-brown, flattened tuber with pale cream to pinkish flesh. Sold whole or as cut chunks; raw yam can itch the hands and mouth.
howToPick: Firm, heavy corm with no soft or wet patches, no mould and no sour smell. Cut pieces should look uniformly pale cream or pink, not dark or slimy.
shelfLife: A whole uncut corm keeps for a few weeks in a cool, dry place (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
